terminal_growth.source: Assumption: roughly long-run nominal US GDP growth; kept below the 10y yield

fade_years.source: Assumption: growth fades linearly from stage-1 to terminal over 10 years

trading_cost_bps.source: Assumption: 10 bp per one-way switch (commission plus spread for a mega-cap)

cash_return.source: Assumption: cash earns 0 in the backtest (conservative for the strategy)

beta_window_years.source: Convention: 5y of daily returns for the CAPM beta

beta_sensitivity.source: same DCF, beta from all daily returns since 2014 vs SPY

factor_model.method: OLS of daily excess return on FF5 + momentum, Newey-West (5 lags) t-stats; rolling 252-day betas every 5 days

CI.gaps: capex not reported in XBRL; total debt not reported in XBRL

CNC.gaps: net loss: P/E not meaningful; negative EBITDA: EV/EBITDA not meaningful

CVS.gaps: total debt not reported in XBRL

valuation.stage1_growth_source: median rolling 5y FCF CAGR, FY2010 onward

beta.source: 5y daily stock vs SPY returns to as-of (OLS slope)

equity_risk_premium.source: Ken French Mkt-RF, arithmetic mean 1926-07 to 202608, x12

pre_tax_cost_of_debt.source: FY2025 interest expense / average total debt (SEC 10-K)

equity_weight.source: market cap (as-of price x Yahoo shares) / (market cap + book debt)

wacc.source: we x ke + (1 - we) x kd x (1 - t)

valuation.convention: valuation date = as-of; FY+1 FCF discounted one full year (conservative)

backtest.signal: long the stock when close > SMA(window), else cash; signal acts next day; window re-picked each Jan 1 by best trailing-3y Sharpe

scenarios.method: stage-1 growth at the 25th/50th/75th percentile of the stock's rolling 5y FCF CAGRs; WACC +/-0.5pp

verdict.rule: supports a long thesis if the base-case DCF value is above the as-of price; the bear case is reported alongside

V.reason: Dropped after M3: the base DCF gave 199.15 vs a 359.33 price (-44.6%), even the bull case was -25.5%, and the price implied 28.4% stage-1 FCF growth vs a 12.9% historical median. Frank re-picked from the shortlist with the same methods and assumptions (no tuning).

notes.prices: Yahoo Finance adjusted close, last trading day of each week (real dates)
notes.dcf_grid: same two-stage DCF as notebook 04; only stage-1 growth and WACC vary
